mapper.select: SELECT peer_id AS peerId, MAX(id) AS lastId, SUM(CASE WHEN to_user_id = #{me} AND is_read = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unreadCount FROM ( SELECT id, CASE WHEN from_user_id = #{me} THEN to_user_id ELSE from_user_id END AS peer_id, to_user_id, is_read FROM message WHERE from_user_id = #{me} OR to_user_id = #{me} ) t GROUP BY peer_id ORDER BY lastId DESC
